title: SandpaneVerification
description: A7 verification methods (design 2026-10-09 §3.7): params and results of verification.list, verification.approve, verification.revoke, verification.run and verification.result. Hand-synced with sandpane_protocol::{VerificationCommand, VerificationListParams, VerificationListResult, VerificationApproveParams, VerificationApproveResult, VerificationRevokeParams, VerificationRevokeResult, VerificationRunParams, VerificationRunResult, VerificationResultParams, VerificationResult, OutputRedaction}. Only syntax-checked by `make schema-lint`; the value-set drift gate does not read this file. Commands run ONLY inside the task's sandbox via `sbx exec -- <name> <argv...>`, never on the host; spawning is gated on a captured-proof sbx version (none in A7, so verification.run answers UNSUPPORTED_SBX_VERSION).

label.description: Trimmed; no control, bidi or invisible format characters. UNTRUSTED display text.

argv.description: An exact argument vector: argv[0] is the program (non-empty, not starting with '-'). Each element at most 4096 BYTES, all together at most 16384 bytes, no NUL and no other control character except TAB and LF (C0, DEL and C1 U+0080-U+009F are refused at approve; a stored command that fails this check is refused at run). Never split, globbed or given to a shell. UNTRUSTED display text: render revealed, element by element, as plain text with C0/C1 controls (except LF and TAB) escaped visibly.

commands.description: Live (not revoked) commands, ordered by approvedAt.

argv.description: An exact argument vector: argv[0] is the program (non-empty, not starting with '-'). Each element at most 4096 BYTES, all together at most 16384 bytes, no NUL and no other control character except TAB and LF (C0, DEL and C1 U+0080-U+009F are refused at approve; a stored command that fails this check is refused at run). Never split, globbed or given to a shell. UNTRUSTED display text: render revealed, element by element, as plain text with C0/C1 controls (except LF and TAB) escaped visibly.

VerificationApproveResult.description: A byte-equal live argv approved again returns the existing command, label unchanged.

expectedSandboxName.description: The task's bound sandbox name the run dialog showed (TaskSummary.sandboxName).

idempotencyKey.description: A2 key; looked up BEFORE every other check. Fingerprint = {taskId, commandId, expectedSandboxName, expectedWorkspaceMode}.

startedSequence.description: Sequence of the verification.started task event.

replayed.description: Present only on a keyed replay (the FIRST response, not current state).

byKind.description: Redaction kind -> count; zero-count kinds absent.

outputWithheld.description: Present only when the redactor was unavailable: NO output was stored (stdout and stderr are empty); never raw output.

argv.description: An exact argument vector: argv[0] is the program (non-empty, not starting with '-'). Each element at most 4096 BYTES, all together at most 16384 bytes, no NUL and no other control character except TAB and LF (C0, DEL and C1 U+0080-U+009F are refused at approve; a stored command that fails this check is refused at run). Never split, globbed or given to a shell. UNTRUSTED display text: render revealed, element by element, as plain text with C0/C1 controls (except LF and TAB) escaped visibly.

workspaceMode.description: Open string (the binding's mode at start).

outcome.description: OPEN string, not an enum: running, exited, signaled, timed_out, spawn_failed, read_failed, possibly_sbx_error, interrupted today; show unknown values as-is.

exitCode.description: The exit status of `sbx exec` (UNVERIFIED that it is the command's own, C-2). Present for exited and possibly_sbx_error only. Never present a 0 as 'passed'.

stdout.description: Capped at 64 KiB of captured bytes, decoded lossily, best-effort redacted BEFORE storage. UNTRUSTED text: plain text only, never HTML/Markdown/terminal; escape C0/C1 except LF/TAB visibly.

outputIncomplete.description: Present (true) only when `sbx exec` exited but its output pipes were still held open, by a descendant that left the process group, after the kill grace: the stored output may be missing a tail. outcome and exitCode are kept as reported; this is never rewritten to timed_out. Absent otherwise.

outputPruned.description: A9 (design 2026-10-09 §3.9 item 2): present (true) only when maintenance.cleanup removed this run's stored stdout/stderr; the record is kept and stdout/stderr are empty. Takes precedence over stdoutTruncated / stderrTruncated / outputIncomplete in rendering ("output removed by maintenance cleanup"). Absent otherwise and from a pre-A9 Core.
